Barbarian Puppet.name: Barbarian Puppet
notes: The Barbarian Puppet enables the Barbarian King to summon a large number of enraged Barbarians when using his ability. These Barbarians do extra damage and move faster while enraged.

The Barbarians spawned by the ability are equal in Level to the Level of Barbarians that the player has researched in the Laboratory . For example, if the player has upgraded Barbarians to Level 5 in the Laboratory, the ability will spawn Level 5 Barbarians.
In addition to the ability, the Barbarian Puppet grants additional hitpoints to the Barbarian King, and increases the amount of health he recovers when using the ability.

The spawned Barbarians can distract defenses, and can be vital when the Barbarian King is going against an Inferno Tower or a Monolith . Due to their large numbers, they can help to destroy defenses for the King. Note that spawning in the Barbarians does not force defenses to retarget, so a spell such as a Freeze Spell should be used to get defenses to stop attacking the King (otherwise, they will remain locked on until the King is defeated or goes out of range).

Note that spawning in the Barbarians does not force defenses to retarget, so a spell such as a Freeze Spell should be used to get defenses to stop attacking the King (otherwise, they will remain locked on until the King is defeated or goes out of range).

It is not advised to use the ability near empty spaces, unless the health regeneration is desperately needed. Such spaces could conceal Giant Bombs or other harmful traps that could wipe out the summoned Barbarians. Likewise, it is not recommended to activate the ability against a Bomb Tower or defensive Town Hall weapon. Both explode upon their destruction, and can similarly destroy the Barbarians.

To maximize the effectiveness of the ability, it is recommended that Barbarians are upgraded as much as possible in the Laboratory, even if they are not used elsewhere in the army, as the level of Barbarians Spawned correspond to the level or Barbarians you have in your Laboratory.

You can use this equipment in a smash-style attack and the Barbarians can have a lot of purposes, from distracting defenses, to destroying single-targeting defenses with enough Barbarians, to trigger traps, or to even help with cleanup if you activate the ability early.

The summoned Barbarians are weak to splash defenses such as Mortars , Wizard Towers , Bomb Towers , Eagle Artillery , and Scattershots , since they will destroy them in a few hits (Scattershots and Eagle Artillery can one-shot Barbarians at any level, however). These defenses should be guarded by Walls , since the raged Barbarians can rush to wipe out any defense extremely quickly. Defenses that do not do splash damage but can target multiple units, such as multi-target Inferno Towers , Multi-Archer Towers , and Firespitters can work against the spawns to a limited extent, but can potentially be overrun by the Barbarians' sheer numbers.

Rage Vial.name: Rage Vial
notes: The Rage Vial appears as a slightly cracked rectangular cubical vial filled with purple liquid resembling the Rage Spell . It has a cubic cork that connects to a chain with a broken link and covers the vial's opening. When equipped, it enrages the Barbarian King when he uses his ability. During this rage, the Barbarian King deals extra damage and moves faster.
In addition to the ability, the Rage Vial grants additional damage per second to the Barbarian King, and increases the amount of health he recovers when using the ability.

The Rage Vial is the most effective means of increasing the Barbarian King's damage, since the Rage Spell has halved effects on him, meaning that it can only grant a 90% damage increase at best (the Grand Warden 's Rage Gem has an even lower damage increase).

Pairing the Rage Vial with Earthquake Boots is a potentially viable strategy, since the earthquake will destroy Walls when the ability is used, possibly opening up a compartment for the Barbarian King to charge through.

The Rage Vial pairs well with the Giant Gauntlet , the high damage increase and the Splash makes the Barbarian king a very strong attacker, and can tear down compartments with ease. The damage reduction on top of the movement speed increase making him lead the way helps tank for other troops.

Combining the Rage Vial with the Vampstache can be useful to maximize the damage dealt during the ability, since the Barbarian King's attack speed is passively increased while equipping the Vampstache. However, Giant Gauntlet is usually a more effective pairing as it allows the King to do considerable area damage, hitting multiple targets at once.

Archer Puppet.name: Archer Puppet
notes: The Archer Puppet is a piece of Hero Equipment for the Archer Queen . It is one of the two Hero Equipment that is unlocked alongside her, the other being the Invisibility Vial .

The Archer Puppet enables the Archer Queen to summon a number of Archers when using her ability. These Archers are granted temporary invisibility, but the Queen is not made invisible at the same time, unless she is using other equipment that grants her invisibility.

The Archers spawned by the ability are equal in Level to the Level of Archers that the player has researched in the Laboratory . For example, if the player has upgraded Archers to Level 5 in the Laboratory, the ability will spawn Level 5 Archers.
In addition to the ability, the Archer Puppet grants additional damage per second to the Archer Queen, and increases the amount of health she recovers when using the ability.

Without an invisibility-granting equipment, the Archer Queen remains vulnerable until the Archers become visible, but spells such as Freeze Spells and Invisibility Spells can buy time for this to happen.
At all Levels, the invisibility time of the Archers are shorter than what the Queen has from the Invisibility Vial, allowing them to be targeted first to tank for the Queen.

The Archers can assist the Queen in doing additional damage as long as they do not get hit or fall victim to a ground trap. They can also be used to counter the Multi-Archer Tower as the tower will spread its fire to three targets as long as the Archers stay alive, but this requires the Archers to first turn visible.
As with usage of the Barbarian Puppet , one should take caution in using the ability near empty spaces in the base, as the summoned Archers can be instantly wiped out by a Bomb or Giant Bomb .

To maximize the effectiveness of the ability, it is recommended that Archers are upgraded as much as possible in the Laboratory, even if they are not used elsewhere in the army, as the Level of Archers spawned correspond to the Level of Archers you have in your Laboratory.
Despite the invisibility, splash defenses and traps can still damage the Archers if they are in the splash radius, mainly cause by the Archer Queen being the target.

Invisibility Vial.name: Invisibility Vial
notes: https://clashofclans.fandom.com/wiki/Invisibility_Vial
The Invisibility Vial is a piece of Hero Equipment for the Archer Queen . It is one of the two Hero Equipments that is unlocked alongside her, the other being the Archer Puppet .

The Invisibility Vial appears as a rectangular cubic vial with aqua liquid inside that resembles the Invisibility Spell , covered with a cubic cork with a green sash and a golden handle that holds it. When equipped, it turns the Archer Queen invisible for a short period of time. During this period, her damage per shot is greatly increased.
In addition to the ability, the Invisibility Vial grants additional hitpoints to the Archer Queen.

The Invisibility Vial increases the Queen's damage to the point where she can destroy any building or troop with just a few shots; this enables the Queen to snipe defenses or other targets easily and relatively safely. When the ability is sufficiently upgraded, the Archer Queen is capable of destroying the Town Hall from full health in the brief ability duration, guaranteeing an additional star for the attack. If the existing damage on a base approaches 50% and the Archer Queen is still undeployed, one can deploy the Queen and activate her ability to safely reach 50% with minimal harm to her. This may be useful for farming strategies.

If the existing damage on a base approaches 50% and the Archer Queen is still undeployed, one can deploy the Queen and activate her ability to safely reach 50% with minimal harm to her. This may be useful for farming strategies.

If the ability has not been used before the Archer Queen is about to be defeated, it will by default automatically activate. However, this feature can be toggled off in the settings (by turning off "Automatically use Hero Abilities on KO"). It is not a fail safe however, as several defenses, such as X-Bows , single-target Inferno Towers and Scattershots can possibly kill her under her ability due to the low health regeneration.

In particular, using the Invisibility Vial with the Archer Puppet has the disadvantage of potentially having the Queen take splash damage from the Archers once they turn visible. The Healer Puppet also carries this problem but to a very limited extent; while splash defenses cannot damage both the grounded Archer Queen and the aerial Healers at the same time, chain-lightning attacks such as that from the Electro Dragon can hit both in the same attack.

The Invisibility Vial will not prevent any projectiles (such as Cannon shots) that are targeting the Archer Queen at the time of the ability's activation from hitting her. If the Eagle Artillery has already locked on and fired on the Queen, activating the Invisibility Vial will not prevent the shots from hitting, which will result in great damage against your Queen. Activating the Vial just before it fires will stop the Eagle Artillery from firing on your Archer Queen, however, and render the Queen temporarily untargetable by the Eagle Artillery as normal.

The Invisibility Vial's mechanism will cause her to be considered as a new target different from the original Archer Queen. Against a defending Electro Dragon, this ability may backfire when you equip the Archer Puppet or Healer Puppet as it may cause her to take two hits from the Electro Dragon's Chain Lightning ability.

Traps still activate even when the ability is triggered, so use this to your advantage and use traps to finish the Queen at low-health. A Tornado Trap , while not providing enough damage to offset her health recovery, can be used to lock the Archer Queen in place and prevent her from reaching valuable targets, wasting most of the ability duration, if not entirely. Giant Bombs will be able to significantly damage her. Defending Super Minions can also do the same thing, since their long shots can pierce through the Queen's ability, and their decent damage and the Low HP recovery of this ability can help destroy a Queen under this ability.

A Tornado Trap , while not providing enough damage to offset her health recovery, can be used to lock the Archer Queen in place and prevent her from reaching valuable targets, wasting most of the ability duration, if not entirely.

Defending Super Minions can also do the same thing, since their long shots can pierce through the Queen's ability, and their decent damage and the Low HP recovery of this ability can help destroy a Queen under this ability.

One can consider slowing down the Archer Queen's attack speed in order to minimize the amount of damage she can do during her ability. At lower levels, this is generally only possible with defending Clan Castle troops, namely the Ice Golem , Headhunter , and Ice Hound , however, at Town Hall 15 and above, the Poison Spell Tower can be effective at doing this.

If Skeleton Traps trigger during her ability duration, she may waste some of her shots on the Skeletons if she is not supported by other troops or attacker's spells. This strategy can work in ground mode with Skeletons directly intercepting the Queen, but ironically can also be effective in air mode if the attacking Archer Queen also uses the Healer Puppet, as the aerial Skeletons will appear in response to the Healers.

notes: Note that invincibility only negates direct damage, and certain effects can still affect invincible units. For example: Slowdown effects, such as inflicted by a Poison Spell Tower or defensive Headhunter , can still work on invincible units; Traps like Giant Bombs may cause knockback on smaller units it cannot kill due to their invincibility; The Air Sweeper will push back invincible units not differently; and Spring Traps can still eliminate affected units completely.

The Eternal Tome's effect is applied at the moment the ability is activated, but will only affect units in the radius: any units that subsequently leave the area of effect before the duration expires will lose invincibility after one second. Units that enter (or are spawned in) the area of effect after the ability is activated will gain invincibility.

The Eternal Tome's invincibility effect can be used to greatly increase the chance that the Battle Blimps reach their intended drop location for the strategies that use them. However, do note that the Eternal Tome does not stop the Air Sweeper 's pushback, so they must be avoided or neutralized with a Freeze Spell . Lightning Spells also work if you can also damage other defenses in its radius, otherwise it is not worth it for this alone.

This pairs well with the Healing Tome , as during the invincibility period, the troops cannot take damage, meaning that the troops can actually get a good amount of healing from the Healing Tome, which could be needed if you are attacking a high-DPS area and could even save low-hitpoint troops from dying if done correctly, and the healing will help the troops take out most of the defenses. It also pairs well with the Rage Gem, because of the extra damage done by the ability, and the Eternal Tome can help negate some of the damage when entering the base, which could be very helpful and allowing the troops to do more damage.

Life Gem.name: Life Gem
notes: The Life Gem appears as an amber gem in a scarlet gemstone held by a brown rope with cracks and has amber color at the bottom right. When equipped, the Grand Warden casts a magical aura around him that grants additional hitpoints to units while they stay within his radius, up to a maximum dictated by the level of the Life Gem. The area of effect is denoted by a circular ring centered around the Warden.
The aura of the Life Gem does not stack with the Apprentice Warden's own life aura, the stronger aura takes precedence.

It is the best at boosting medium troops' health, since large troops do not benefit much because of the cap, while small troops will not get the maximum health increase. Thus making it a good choice in Hybrid attacks (especially the Super Hog Rider ), Lavaloon, GoWiPe, Witch spam, or basically any attack that requires a lot of small or medium troops to make them survive for longer. Since it is not as effective on troops with high hitpoints on a per capacity basis, it is better to use an Apprentice Warden for their health increase and use a different equipment such as the Rage Gem instead as the aura from him does not have a cap.

Since it is not as effective on troops with high hitpoints on a per capacity basis, it is better to use an Apprentice Warden for their health increase and use a different equipment such as the Rage Gem instead as the aura from him does not have a cap.

When a troop that does not have full HP enters the range of the aura, the amount of health increase is calculated using the amount of HP that the troop currently has, not based on its maximum HP, and the same caps apply for health increase. Note that the troop in the aura will first take the damage from the extra HP from the warden, and then exhaust its normal hitpoints from the damage. The HP bar will also scale accordingly.

High damage defenses, such as single-target Inferno Towers , Scattershots , or Monolith can partly ignore this ability.

Seeking Shield.name: Seeking Shield
notes: The shield prioritizes defenses, so if at least four defenses remain, the shield will exclusively hit defenses. If there are less than four defenses remaining, the shield will hit all remaining defenses before hitting defending troops or non-defensive buildings for its remaining targets (if any such targets exist). The shield cannot hit a given target more than once.

It is best used to destroy or cripple key defenses or to help with cleanup (e.g., Builder's Huts in the corner). Because the shield can travel any distance required to hit its targets, it can assist with destroying isolated defenses left behind, which could otherwise have caused time fails.
Although generally not a reliable method, the Seeking Shield can trigger the Invisibility Spell Tower by hitting a defense near it, so long as the Royal Champion remains alive.

It pairs well with the Hog Rider Puppet : the Seeking Shield first deals some damage to defenses in a compartment, the Royal Champion will stop being targeted by defenses, and the Hog Riders spawned will take out the defenses in such compartments. However, splash defenses can counter this easily, so using something to take out such splash defenses or simply using the Seeking Shield to take them out partially can help in this strategy succeeding.

However, splash defenses can counter this easily, so using something to take out such splash defenses or simply using the Seeking Shield to take them out partially can help in this strategy succeeding.
When attacking a base and you are running low on time, this ability can also be useful on cleanup due to its high damage, high speed, and the amount of targets that it can hit, being 4.

The shield targets the nearest defenses similar to an Electro Dragon 's chain (albeit only seeing defensive buildings as viable targets). You can take advantage of this by placing defenses in a manner to prevent key defenses from being hit.

Royal Gem.name: Royal Gem
notes: The Royal Gem appears as an orange gem which grows yellow to the bottom, wrapped by a blue cloth around the top. When equipped, it grants a large amount of health recovery to the Royal Champion when she uses the ability. This compounds additively with the health recovery stat that she has innately.
In addition, the Royal Gem increases the Royal Champion's damage per second and hit points when equipped.
The Royal Gem is best activated in the middle of the base where the hero has low health to guarantee the maximum health recovery from this ability.

It can be paired with the Hog Rider Puppet when you are going up against a single Inferno Tower or a Monolith . The Royal Champion will gain almost all of her health back, also turning invisible, causing defenses to target the Hog Riders, and they will then subsequently destroy said defense.

When paired alongside the Haste Vial, this allows for Royal Charges to be possible with the help of Invisibility Spells to keep her invisible, ensuring her survivability. This can be further improved if the Spirit Fox is paired with the Royal Champion.

The Royal Gem can also be paired with the Seeking Shield , as it helps the Champion gain health while destroying or dealing significant damage to four defenses, which can be very helpful for your main army to take down later.
While this looks like a generic ability, the health recovery can be massive and can help the champion stay alive longer and make the attack more effective.

Earthquake Boots.name: Earthquake Boots
notes: The Earthquake Boots appears as a pair of brown boots which have light yellow collars, a brown strap held by a buckle, and golden toe guards with spikes on them. When equipped, it enables the Barbarian King to create an earthquake when using his ability. This earthquake instantly destroys Walls at any level and does significant damage to buildings and defending troops proportional to their maximum hitpoints within a 16-tile diameter, or 8 tiles centered on where the Earthquake Boots was activated. The earthquake caused by Earthquake Boots is able to damage resource storages, unlike conventional Earthquake Spells .
In addition to the ability, the Earthquake Boots also increases the damage per second and maximum hitpoints of the Barbarian King when equipped.

The Earthquake Boots can be seen as an alternative to Earthquake Spells , as it is able to destroy any Level of Walls, while 4 Earthquake Spells are required to do the same thing. It also has a much larger radius, being able to affect many more buildings compared to 4 Earthquake Spells.

Sometimes, the ability might allow an early Town Hall weapon activation due to the earthquake, and since it has a larger radius then the Earthquake Spell, many players can activate the weapon early, so be careful.

The Earthquake Boots' wall-breaking ability works better on tight bases with lots of compartments than on bases with fewer compartments. However, it should be noted that opening access to a large number of compartments may not always be desirable, and so one's attack plan must factor what the Barbarian King expects to do with this ability.
The bonus damage can help tackle small ground Clan Castle troops , but cannot destroy the Skeletons summoned from Skeleton Traps .
The troop percentage damage is highly effective against high health ground Clan Castle troops and defending Heroes .

Placing separate layers of Walls 9 tiles apart prevents the Earthquake Boots from destroying both layers at once if the Barbarian King is behind both layers. As mentioned above, having fewer compartments in the wall layout reduces the possible value from the ability.

Hog Rider Puppet.name: Hog Rider Puppet
notes: The Hog Rider Puppet enables the Royal Champion to summon a number of Hog Riders when using her ability. Additionally, upon activation, she turns invisible for a short duration, which, among other things, allows these Hog Riders to tank for her, all while distracting defenses from targeting her. Similar to the Healer Puppet and unlike the Barbarian and Archer Puppets , the level of Hog Riders depends on the level of the Hog Rider Puppet and not on the level of Hog Riders the player has researched in the Laboratory .

Similar to the Healer Puppet and unlike the Barbarian and Archer Puppets , the level of Hog Riders depends on the level of the Hog Rider Puppet and not on the level of Hog Riders the player has researched in the Laboratory .
In addition to the ability, the Hog Rider Puppet grants additional hitpoints to the Royal Champion and also increases the amount of health she recovers when using the ability.

The Hog Rider Puppet can be used to add some extra punch to a solo Royal Champion. The summoned Hogs can assist her in clearing out entire compartments, in addition to tanking for her. Because the Hogs target defenses, they can help destroy them, especially if the Champion is distracted by defending troops or Heroes in said compartment. However, compartments with a lot of splash defenses can counter said ability, and compartments that you think might contain a lot of traps are also not good, as the Hogs will be destroyed quickly.
However, compartments with a lot of splash defenses can counter said ability, and compartments that you think might contain a lot of traps are also not good, as the Hogs will be destroyed quickly.

If you have leveled up other equipment to a high level and would like to use this, it might be better to level up this equipment to a similar level and then use it, as a low-level Puppet might spawn weak Hog Riders that are not as effective as a high-level one, and they will probably be destroyed by the high number of splash defenses inside the base.

However, if the damage is over 50% or if the Town Hall weapon has been activated beforehand, the Town Hall will activate and this could direct some Hog Riders over, which can make this late ability a double-edged sword. On one hand, the Hog Riders can take out the Town Hall and trigger the devastating Poison Bomb early, but if they do not, you will get another strong defense for your main army to tackle.

It can also be used to stop defenses from targeting her, such as single-target Inferno Towers, as this ability turns her invisible for one second. The Hog Riders can also be used to destroy said defense quickly due to their speed, as well as to distract other defenses.

It can be paired with the Seeking Shield , since the Shield can take out or cripple some defenses, which the Hog Riders will take out in quick succession. Despite the risk of the low health regeneration making her easily get taken out if defenses manage to target her, the Hog Rider can tank for her.

It is very useful to use it alongside the Royal Gem , as combined with the Hog Rider Puppet, she will be able to regenerate most of her health, if not her entire health bar, in battle, and prevent her from being taken down prematurely.

The Hog Rider Puppet pairs well with the Haste Vial , as the Royal Champion turns invisible for a short while, allowing the Hog Riders to tank damage for her while she dashes in to damage the defenses in the core.
If the Super Minions fire or Headhunters throw their cards at the Royal Champion, they can still hit her because their projectiles can still pierce through the ability, so be careful.

Giant Gauntlet.name: Giant Gauntlet

raw.Unlock Requirement: Buy in Cookie Rumble event for 3,100 Buy in Toyshop Throwdown event for 3,100 Buy in Cosmic Rock event for 3,100 Buy in Equipment Blast event for 3,100 Purchasable from the Trader for 1,500 or purchasable from the League Shop for 750

notes: The Giant Gauntlet is a bronze gauntlet with two spikes on top worn by the Barbarian King, making him gigantic when using his ability. While gigantic, the Barbarian King does grounded splash damage for his attacks in a huge radius, and he takes less damage for the duration of the ability.
In addition to its ability, the Giant Gauntlet grants additional damage to the Barbarian King, and give him self healing every second.

However, when using the Rage Vial, it only lasts for 10 seconds at all levels, while the Giant Gauntlet lasts for 12 seconds at level 1, and 17 seconds at max level. In that case, the Barbarian King might not destroy all crucial defenses if you depend on the extra damage from him.
The Earthquake Boots can damage buildings around him, as well as reducing the damage from high-damage defenses. Also, his splash damage can finish off weakened and clumped defenses.

When combined with the Vampstache , the extra attack speed is beneficial, and when paired with a Rage Spell, he could easily wreak havoc to many compartments and destroy any defenses. However, hitting multiple targets during the ability does not heal him for however many targets he hit, as it heals based on each attack only.

The health recovered by the King's ability is effectively multiplied (thanks to the damage reduction of the ability). To maximize this advantage, you have the option of pairing the Giant Gauntlet with the Barbarian Puppet or Rage Vial, which grants additional health recovery, or Spiky Ball extra Troop Healings. It is recommended not to use the ability at a high health in order to not waste too much effective health regeneration, unless the benefit of destroying many defenses at once outweighs the downsides of activating the ability early.

Good spacing of key defenses can help prevent the Barbarian King from getting massive value from a single use of his ability. Even then, you should remember to always separate them with multiple layers of Walls and/or an entire compartment in between. If the Barbarian King is also using the Rage Vial, he can reach your other defenses quickly after having destroyed one. Note that the Barbarian King can always hit buildings, even behind Walls (even if they are separated from the Wall by a single tile).
Note that the Barbarian King can always hit buildings, even behind Walls (even if they are separated from the Wall by a single tile).

The Giant Gauntlet's damage reduction at higher levels mean that the only real damage you can get on the Barbarian King is the Monolith and the single-target Inferno Towers. Scattershots , X-Bows , and Ricochet Cannons paired with other defenses will also help in countering his ability. However, try not to put all of these defenses in a single place, because the ability will simply hit all of them, thus removing some key defenses of the base. Traps will also help a bit, although the Giant Bomb is the only trap that can deal some damage to him. Indeed, the damage of the other traps done to the King is negligible.

Vampstache.name: Vampstache
notes: The Vampstache appears to be a light-yellow jagged mustache with the tips on the front being scarlet in color. It allows the Barbarian King to heal himself every time he lands an attack. In addition, the Vampstache grants the Barbarian King increased damage per second and attack speed. The sole exception to his self-healing is when the Barbarian King is being revived by the Phoenix , in which case he is unable to heal.
The sole exception to his self-healing is when the Barbarian King is being revived by the Phoenix , in which case he is unable to heal.
To get the maximum potential of healing, the Barbarian King must be attacking a high-hitpoint building such as walls and resource storages.
Upgrading the equipment makes the lifesteal stronger and increasing the King's attack speed, triggering the lifesteal more rapidly, increasing his tanking potential.

Things that prevent the Barbarian King from taking damage can assist him in his efforts to heal. Examples include the Invisibility Spell and Spirit Fox , but also the Eternal Tome ability from the Grand Warden . The Giant Gauntlet 's damage reduction can also help to some extent.

It can also prove effective in King Walks, as the high HP buildings on the edge will make sure that he constantly gets healed, and the fact that many defenses cannot target the edge of the base, the King will mostly be at full health, thus keeping it alive.

Upgrading it will also increase his attack speed, which can be helpful for getting extra damage on the core of the base; This also increases the healing overall, since the greater hit speed can help with HP recovery, which can be very useful in many situations.

At higher Town Hall levels, since the healing will generally be much less than the high amounts of damage, the King will take some damage for sure, and it might even force an ability if the King is reduced to low health, so be careful when using this against higher Town Hall levels.

Against higher-level Vampstache users, the Barbarian King may also be able to outheal basic point defenses like a single Cannon , so one should not spread out their defenses too far apart. It is even possible for the King to outheal a Giga Inferno if no defenses are supporting it.

Slowing down the Barbarian King's attack rate can prove effective, as he only heals when he attacks. This can be done directly by using defending Headhunters or Ice Golems , or with a Poison Spell Tower at higher levels. Placing Walls to funnel the Barbarian King is a possible strategy, since he may spend some time to walk to his next target; however, this will not work if the King attacks the Walls directly.

Haste Vial.name: Haste Vial
notes: In addition to the ability, the Haste Vial grants additional damage per second and increased attack speed to the Royal Champion. The attack speed increase by the ability is multiplicative on top of the passive attack speed increase. For instance, at max level, the Royal Champion's passive attack rate is 116% that of normal; activating the ability doubles this to 232%.

The attack speed increase by the ability is multiplicative on top of the passive attack speed increase. For instance, at max level, the Royal Champion's passive attack rate is 116% that of normal; activating the ability doubles this to 232%.

The Haste Vial greatly boosts the Royal Champion's damage potential for a short duration. Use it in the core of a base to decimate its defenses more quickly. It can alternatively be used to destroy compartments quickly, or when the Champion reaches the core of the base to run away from the Poison Bomb ,and to get some health recovery from the ability itself. Pairing this with the Royal Gem would be good, since it will increase her survivability while tackling defenses in the center of the base.

It can alternatively be used to destroy compartments quickly, or when the Champion reaches the core of the base to run away from the Poison Bomb ,and to get some health recovery from the ability itself.

The Haste Vial pairs well with the Hog Rider Puppet , as the Royal Champion turns invisible for a short while, allowing the Hog Riders to tank damage for her while she dashes in to damage the defenses in the core.

The Rocket Spear has anti-synergy with Haste Vial as her increased attack speed means that she will throw additional spears before prior spears land, which can result in wasted rocket spears, unless she is close enough to that said defense, defeating the purpose of the extended range.

Normally, the Royal Champion can run away from the Poison Bomb to avoid the Poison damage. Placing defenses around the Town Hall will make sure that the Royal Champion gets slowed down by the Poison from the Poison Bomb.

Do not put traps where you think you can defeat a low-HP Royal Champion who is going to go through with a Haste Vial, as she can outrun traps when activated! However, if you put a defense there for the Champion to target, that will work well, especially if she is attacking a tanky defense such as the Town Hall Giga Inferno .
However, if you put a defense there for the Champion to target, that will work well, especially if she is attacking a tanky defense such as the Town Hall Giga Inferno .

Rocket Spear.name: Rocket Spear

raw.Unlock Requirement: Buy in Super Wall Breaker Spotlight event for 3,100 Buy in Snake Festival event for 3,100 Buy in Equipment Blast event for 3,100 Buy in Wise Warriors event for 3,100 or purchasable from the Trader for 1,500

notes: The Rocket Spear is the first epic piece of Hero Equipment for the Royal Champion . It was first seen in the "Fear the Rocket Spear!" challenge in June 8, 2024, and made its debut in the Super Wall Breaker Spotlight event starting June 11, 2024. Since August 13, 2024, it may appear in the Trader , where it is obtainable for 1,500 Gems.

The Rocket Spear appears as a pointed spear which is mostly golden, and has a red firework tied to it. When equipped, the Royal Champion throws rocket-propelled spears for the next few attacks at the closest defense. These spears can be thrown by the Royal Champion from a long range of 10 tiles, do additional damage compared to her normal attacks, and do splash damage in a small area (0.8 tiles radius) upon impact.

The Rocket Spear allows the Royal Champion to briefly serve as a long-range defense sniper. She can safely pick off short and medium-range defenses like Bomb Towers , the defending Grand Warden , and Single-Target Inferno Towers without facing retaliation. If positioned correctly, she can also outrange the Town Hall , multi-target Inferno Towers, Multi-Archer Towers , and Scattershots . The defenses that cannot be outranged by the ability are X-Bows , Mortars , Eagle Artillery (if activated), Inferno Artillery and the Monolith .
The defenses that cannot be outranged by the ability are X-Bows , Mortars , Eagle Artillery (if activated), Inferno Artillery and the Monolith .

To make the most of her extended range during the ability, it is often best to activate her ability immediately after she is deployed. However, in rare cases, she can instead utilize the ability for its damage increase and/or splash damage capabilities, the latter of which allows her to be effective against Skeleton Traps and defending Clan Castle troops.

The Royal Gem is not a viable pairing when sniping defenses, as its health regeneration will be wasted. The Haste Vial is also poor for this purpose, her increased attack speed means that she will throw additional spears before prior spears land, which can result in wasted rocket spears, unless if she is close enough to that said defense, defeating the purpose of the extended range.

The best defense against the Royal Champion wielding the Rocket Spear is the X-Bow as it cannot be outranged by Rocket Spear and does not need an activation housing space count to activate like the Eagle Artillery. It is best to set it to Ground Mode to increase its attack radius.
Skeletons spawned from the Skeleton Trap, when spaced enough from each other, can waste a few of the Rocket Spears on them, preventing her from getting more value.

High-damage defenses can easily take out the Royal Champion before she can throw all her spears, wasting the ability. However, she must be close enough to the range of defenses, such as X-Bows, single-target Inferno Towers or Monoliths.
However, she must be close enough to the range of defenses, such as X-Bows, single-target Inferno Towers or Monoliths.

Spiky Ball.name: Spiky Ball

raw.Unlock Requirement: Buy in Clash with Haaland event for 3,100 Buy in Snake Festival event for 3,100 Buy in Splash Bash event for 3,100 Buy in Meltdown Mayhem event for 3,100 But in Equipment Blast event for 3,100 or purchasable from the Trader for 1,500

notes: The Spiky Ball allows the Barbarian King to launch a spiked ball that ricochets across multiple buildings, damaging each building hit. The Spiky Ball will not target defending troops unless it has already hit every targetable building. Buildings cannot be hit twice by the Spiky Ball. If the Spiky Ball does attack troops, it can only hit ground troops, and cannot attack air troops.
The Spiky Ball will not target defending troops unless it has already hit every targetable building. Buildings cannot be hit twice by the Spiky Ball.
In addition to the ability, the Spiky Ball grants additional damage per second and hitpoints to the Barbarian King.

With the Earthquake Boots , the combination of the proportional damage and from the Spiky Ball itself can destroy every building except the Town Hall , which is extremely useful against the core of the base with high value defenses that have high health.

The Spiky Ball has more damage than the Giant Arrow , but less damage than that of the Fireball . As a Hero Equipment providing direct damage, it has its own niches to excel in where the other two may struggle; because it chains between nearby buildings, it can clear irregular clusters of buildings that the Giant Arrow and Fireball might not. The Spiky Ball is also not as timing-dependent as them, making it somewhat easier to use.

It is quite unpredictable at first if you have not funneled and routed correctly and is a challenging piece of equipment to get high value off. However, if you have a correct funnel and a correct timing, it could be extremely effective at dealing with tanky buildings, defenses and taking out crucial targets.

It is comparable to the Seeking Shield , since they both hit buildings, dealing damage. While the Seeking Shield hits defenses only and deals less damage, the Spiky Ball deals more damage, hits more targets, but targets any building, which can be a double-edged sword.
Using Invisibility Spells and Overgrowth Spells can also help to path this ability, which can gain more value for the Barbarian King's ability.

Frozen Arrow.name: Frozen Arrow

raw.Unlock Requirement: Buy in Dragon Festival event for 3,100 Buy in Toyshop Throwdown event for 3,100 Buy in Cosmic Rock event for 3,100 But in Equipment Blast event for 3,100 Purchasable from the Trader for 1,500 or purchasable from the League Shop for 750

notes: The Frozen Arrow appears as a large arrow with an icy tip and has icicles going to the bottom. When equipped, it gives the Archer Queen the ability to slow down targets she hits for a brief period of time. The frost effect quickly wears off from the target if it stops being targeted.
In addition to the ability, the Frozen Arrow grants additional damage per second to the Archer Queen.

This ability is excellent against strong defensive buildings like a single-target Inferno Tower , Monolith , Firespitter , Air Defense , or a Scattershot . When the Frozen Arrow is upgraded to a sufficiently high level, the threat from that defense will be largely neutralized due to their greatly reduced firing speed. However, at lower levels, the slowdown is not a lot when compared with higher levels by a significant margin, so leveling up this piece of hero equipment will be essential for any attack and can increase the value you can get from the Queen. The slowdown effect is also more effective against defenses that take a long time to attack, like the activated Eagle Artillery .

However, at lower levels, the slowdown is not a lot when compared with higher levels by a significant margin, so leveling up this piece of hero equipment will be essential for any attack and can increase the value you can get from the Queen.
The slowdown effect is also more effective against defenses that take a long time to attack, like the activated Eagle Artillery .

The Frozen Arrow's slowdown utility also applies to defending Clan Castle troops and Heroes , greatly hindering their capabilities if frosted. Additionally, the frost effect stacks with a Poison Spell ; if both are applied at once, affected units may find it nearly impossible to move or attack. It is also worth noting that the effect also stacks with the slowdown effect of the Frosty , assuming if you have him as your pet.
It is also worth noting that the effect also stacks with the slowdown effect of the Frosty , assuming if you have him as your pet.

Because the Frozen Arrow's frost duration is at least greater than the Archer Queen's normal attack speed, targets hit by the Frozen Arrow will remain frosted as long as the Archer Queen attacks them.

This piece of equipment can help to reduce damage dealt to the Queen, and it can help in Queen Walks on the outside of the base by slowing down defenses that might lower the Queen's HP significantly, which can increase the odds of the walk succeeding.
The Frozen Arrow is also great in Queen Charges, as it helps to slow down crucial defenses that can ruin the charge, and it is overall a very versatile piece of equipment for attack.

It is best paired with the Healer Puppet , which can increase the Queen's survivability further by giving her extra healing and reserving more army slots to other offensive troops that can improve the attack. The Invisibility Vial is also a great choice for the Queen with this equipment, since rendering her invisible can help her deal extra damage, and can stop her from being targeted if she faces too much enemy fire. It is not recommended to pair with the Giant Arrow , since it will only increases damage per second after the ability is used while not providing any utility like extra healing nor increased survivability.

The Invisibility Vial is also a great choice for the Queen with this equipment, since rendering her invisible can help her deal extra damage, and can stop her from being targeted if she faces too much enemy fire.

It is not recommended to pair with the Giant Arrow , since it will only increases damage per second after the ability is used while not providing any utility like extra healing nor increased survivability.

The Frozen Arrow takes at least one attack to slow something, and it does not increase first attacking speed or general attack speed like the active and passive abilities of the Haste Vial , but the Heroic Torch or Haste Spell can be used to at least make the Archer Queen move faster, to reduce the time the defense gets to attack her before she is able to slow it down.

Multiple buildings , Heroes , and Clan Castle troops will make it hard for the Archer Queen to come through. Because the Frozen Arrow can generally only keep one target frosted at a time, swarms of defending targets can overwhelm the Archer Queen. The Witch works excellently for this purpose, being able to summon Skeletons to distract the Archer Queen heavily. The Furnace can also summon Firemites that distract the Queen, with its summoned units dealing splash damage when they reach her.
The Witch works excellently for this purpose, being able to summon Skeletons to distract the Archer Queen heavily.
The Furnace can also summon Firemites that distract the Queen, with its summoned units dealing splash damage when they reach her.

Distractions like Skeleton Traps can distract the Archer Queen from attacking powerful defenses, which allows them to defrost and attack as normal for as long as the distraction exists. The Invisibility Spell Tower can be used to forcibly disengage the Queen from a strong defense, but do note that its activation will be delayed if the Spell Tower itself is being targeted.

Methods to slow down the Archer Queen's attack speed can help in mitigating the effects of the Frozen Arrow as well as the Queen's ability to utilize it. Defending Headhunters and Ice Golems are generally the only accessible methods at lower levels, but Poison Spell Towers can be used at Town Hall 15 and above.

Monolith Arrow.name: Monolith Arrow

raw.Unlock Requirement: Buy in Anime Fury Medal Event for 3,100 or purchasable from the Trader for 1,500

notes: The Monolith Arrow resembles a large arrow with a diamond-shaped purple tip with a glowing pink aura in the center and a light yellow base near the top of the handle.

Note that the ability damage decreases only once the described thresholds of 180 and 250 are surpassed, not when they are equalled. Thus the Monolith Arrow will still have maximum damage when exactly 180 housing space has been deployed, and will remain in its second damage stage with exactly 250 housing space deployed.

Every three levels, the bonus damage percentage for all three tiers is increased (by anywhere between 0.1% and 0.5%, depending on the tier); starting at level 9, the damage reduction is also increased (by 1% each time).

The Monolith Arrow is effective against high-health targets, such as the Town Hall , defending Guardians , and Walls . It can be used to trivialize battles against the Giant Dragon and M.O.M.M.A in the Single Player Campaign similarly, because it affects all units regardless of hitpoints. Upgrading it allows the Archer Queen to deal with higher-hitpoint units, therefore increasing its effectiveness.

Because the Archer Queen is commonly overwhelmed by small troops like Skeletons , the Monolith Arrow will be wasted on them, giving more time for defenses to quickly take her out before she does too much damage. Ice Golems can also do the same, as their death freeze will impede her progress in a Queen Charge, and possibly cause a time fail if the base is well-designed.
Ice Golems can also do the same, as their death freeze will impede her progress in a Queen Charge, and possibly cause a time fail if the base is well-designed.

Since the Archer Queen can deal bonus damage to Walls with the Monolith Arrow, so placing too few compartments can easily allow her to break through, even when the Hero Equipment is at its lowest bonus damage.

Giant Arrow.name: Giant Arrow
notes: The Giant Arrow appears as a large arrow with a very large pointed tip, a long wooden shaft, and red fletchings which when equipped, enables the Archer Queen to launch an extremely large arrow which pierces everything in its path when she uses her ability, much like the Super Archer 's Sharp Shot ability, but deals much more damage, travels through the entire village, and is a one-time use. The arrow deals double damage to Air Defenses .

The direction that the Giant Arrow travels depends on where the Archer Queen's current target is, relative to her location at the moment the ability is used; the Giant Arrow will travel a straight line that passes through these two locations. If the Archer Queen has no target (e.g. all remaining targets are hidden by an Invisibility Spell ), she will simply fire the Giant Arrow in the direction she is facing.
If the Archer Queen has no target (e.g. all remaining targets are hidden by an Invisibility Spell ), she will simply fire the Giant Arrow in the direction she is facing.

When doing a Queen Walk, the best equipment to use are the Healer Puppet and the Giant Arrow. The goal for this is to destroy key defenses. When the Archer Queen is aligned to the key building she is targeting, immediately press her ability, and the Healers will spawn. Do take note however, as the low-leveled Healer Puppet will only spawn 1-2 Healers. Best used on aerial attacks to destroy Air Defenses and Sweepers. If you have the Frozen Arrow unlocked, it can be used on ground attacks, as the Archer Queen's arrows will slow down defenses, increasing her survivability.
If you have the Frozen Arrow unlocked, it can be used on ground attacks, as the Archer Queen's arrows will slow down defenses, increasing her survivability.

The Giant Arrow may activate the Giga Tesla or Giga Inferno if it pierces through them. This may be helpful if you want to direct defense targeting troops like Hog Riders or Royal Champion towards it, but it could also backfire, as an early activation will cause significant damage to the rest of the army.

Shooting the Giant Arrow towards the area of coverage of an Invisibility Spell Tower can be used as a means to trigger the spell early, preventing it from messing up the attack once it reaches the vicinity of the tower. However, the Invisibility Spell Tower has a relatively short cooldown, so the ability should not be used too early, lest the tower reload in time.

Designing your base slightly unsymmetrical and the defenses being slightly askew might help confuse your opponent. While it might not look good and the high number of defenses at higher levels might not allow, putting defenses askew might mean that the opponent might not get much value from it because the buildings are not in a straight line, even when looking at it feels like one. It can also be a good counter to Electro Dragons , since the chain lightning might not hit a building behind, because it might count as two tiles for buildings, even if it looks like as if it is one tile.

It can also be a good counter to Electro Dragons , since the chain lightning might not hit a building behind, because it might count as two tiles for buildings, even if it looks like as if it is one tile.

Heroic Torch.name: Heroic Torch

raw.Unlock Requirement: Buy in Splash Bash event for 3,100 Buy in Equipment Blast event for 3,100 or purchasable from the Trader for 1,500

notes: The Heroic Torch is an Epic piece of Hero Equipment for the Grand Warden that was released on August 7th, 2025, within the Splash Bash Event.

The Heroic Torch is a large golden-and-white stick with a lamp on top containing a multi-colored flame in it. When activated, the Heroic Torch releases a radial burst to any units in his aura. Affected units move faster, take reduced damage, and gain the ability to move through Walls if they cannot already bypass them. The Grand Warden himself also benefits from all of the effects. Siege Machines are not affected in any way. Other Heroes will gain only half the speed boost, but gain the other benefits in full.

Similar to the Eternal Tome , any units that leave the aura will lose its effects after 1 second, while any units that enter or return to the aura will gain the effects as long as the ability is active.

The Heroic Torch is very useful for ground troops that cannot jump, such as Electro Titans , P.E.K.K.As , Yetis , Bears , and Valkyries , allowing for a great push to the base. When defensive buildings are targeting the army, the damage reduction will help deal with them as the army destroys them quickly before they deal too much damage to them, so long as they do not stray too away from the main army.

This can assist with ground pushes particularly when approaching the center, allowing the troops to quickly go through the central compartments, destroying everything in the process, and when paired with the Eternal Tome and Rage Spell , this combo can ravage defenses in a ground push.

Try and make bigger compartments, as this will make the troops take longer to take out defenses, which means that they might not take much advantage on taking out the wall. Actually, this might even turn out in your favor if they are close to your core defenses and have little protection from tanks.

Invisibility Spell Towers can divert the main army from attacking the most important part of the base, Poison Spell Towers and defending Ice Golems can delay them, and Rage Spell Towers can deal heavy damage when paired with high-damage defenses like the Multi-Gear Tower , Firespitters , and Scattershots .

Healer Puppet.name: Healer Puppet
notes: https://clashofclans.fandom.com/wiki/Healer_Puppet
The Healer Puppet is a piece of Common Hero Equipment for the Archer Queen . It is unlocked when the Blacksmith is upgraded to level 5, which requires Town Hall level 12 to do so.

The Healer Puppet appears as a voodoo doll with button eyes, golden-yellow clothing and wings, resembling that of a Healer . When equipped, it enables the Archer Queen to summon a number of Healers when using her ability depending on its level. Unlike the Barbarian and Archer Puppets , the level of Healers depends on the level of the Healer Puppet, and not the level of Healers the player has researched in the Laboratory .

In addition to the ability, the Healer Puppet grants additional hitpoints to the Archer Queen, and grants a small amount of self-healing per second to her.

It is best used in Queen Walks and Charges, for some extra Healers to heal you up. Alternatively, you can use it to replace some Healers lost due to air traps and/or air defenses and to add some after using a Recall Spell.

It is good with the Recall Spell , as you can get extra healers after you recalled the queen, which is beneficial or even critical in certain scenarios, and it allows other crucial troops to be recalled alongside the Queen, which can be great in a lot of scenarios.
Leveling up this ability is crucial: A low-leveled ability might give you less healing, which could potentially spoil up the attack if there is simply too much damage dealt to the Queen alone!

The Healers' utility are not limited to just healing the Archer Queen. As normal Healers, they can heal any other damaged Hero or troop, and as such can serve to support smash attacks if you are sending the Queen alongside the main army.

It is possible to use the summoned Healers as bait to trigger air traps to pave way for an air attack, but this is generally only used as a last resort as it is a wasted hero equipment slot unless it is difficult to get a less expensive troop like a Balloon where you intend to use the ability. If the Super Troop is boosted, Rocket Balloons will generally supersede the need for this, due to their fast movement speed when initially deployed.

Healer Puppet can be triggered instantly to benefit from the Healers immediately, the minor loss of health regeneration from the base ability or other equipment combo will eventually be made up by the Healers and the passive self healing. This property makes it combo well with Archer Puppet , Giant Arrow , and Frozen Arrow .

Put air traps where your opponent might use this ability: This will cripple the Healers, or possibly destroy them outright. The Seeking Air Mine is by far and away the most effective tool to do this (a level 3 or higher one will one-shot any Healer), but groups of Air Bombs can work against lower-leveled Healers. A possible use is in the core of the base, where the queen requires more healing. Another place is where someone will likely place their Recall Spell after they destroyed part of a base.

Against ground attacks, Skeleton Traps can be counterintuitively set to air mode to distract an Archer Queen using the Healer Puppet. As these traps do not trigger against other ground troops, setting them to air mode allows them to spawn skeletons the moment the Queen summons Healers. This distraction is especially devastating if the Queen is also using the Invisibility Vial , as it can waste that ability's duration.

Rage Gem.name: Rage Gem
notes: The Rage Gem appears to be a purple gemstone shaped like a vial which as a burgundy cover and is held by a burgundy rope. When equipped, it casts a purple magical aura around the Grand Warden that grants additional damage to units while they stay within the aura's radius. The area of effect is denoted by a circular ring centered around the Warden. However, the aura disappears when he is defeated in battle.
The Rage Gem aura's percent damage increase has no effect on the Grand Warden himself, however he does gain increased damage per second and attack speed by having it equipped.

In the case of Sneezy 's rage, the Rage Gem will supersede her own.

One thing this could be paired up with the Rage Gem is the Eternal Tome , as the Rage Gem will increase the damage, while as the troops is invulnerable when they tackle the core of the base and the Town Hall. Be aware that defensive spells from the Giga Inferno and Poison Spell Tower can still slow the attack down.

Defenses and Clan Castle units which slow down or distract the advance of enemy units such as the Poison Spell Tower, Skeleton Traps, Ice Golems and Headhunters can prove to be effective, and can be the difference between a time fail and a three star.

Major defenses such as Ricochet Cannons , Multi-Archer Towers and the Town Hall boosted by a Rage Spell Tower can prove to be very effective as these defenses will take down targets as quickly as possible. However, this strategy may be ineffective if the Eternal Tome is involved, unless if there are defending units such as Ice Golems to freeze their units and waste the ability duration.

Snake Bracelet.name: Snake Bracelet

raw.Unlock Requirement: Buy in Snake Festival event for 3,100 Buy in Dark Deal event for 3,100 Buy in Equipment Blast event for 3,100 or purchasable from the Trader for 1,500

notes: The Barbarian King summons Snakes whenever he takes 300 points of damage; if he takes more than 300 damage in a single hit, he can summon multiple Snakes at a time. The number of Snakes that can be summoned through the Snake Bracelet is limited.
In addition, the Snake Bracelet grants the Barbarian King increased damage per second, hitpoints, and attack speed.
It is recommended to upgrade the Snake Bracelet to level 15 or 18, as he will gain an additional 8 Snakes at these levels to the summoning limit, allowing him to distract defenses more often.

The Barbarian Puppet only provides similar max health comparable to Spiky Ball with no damage boost, with the ability being useless as the Barbarians cannot do as much as Spiky Ball, while Snakes already provide protection at a steady stream. Even then, the snake's usefulness is just a bonus because of higher Town Halls have more splash damage which can quickly defeat all the Snakes and Barbarians, with the stat boosts of the Snake Bracelet being the main highlight.
The Rage Vial ability mostly recovery his health only, as the extra damage and speed cannot do as much damage as Spiky Ball.

The King being outside means the Earthquake Boots ability is way less effective, removing Walls and allowing the King to enter deeper into the base can be a detriment to this role as he is alone most of the time and can get focus fired.

The King being outside also means Giant Gauntlet ability is way less effective as he does not need to tank heavy damage nor have multiple buildings within reach to deal splash damage, and Snakes spawn at a lower rate during the ability because of the damage reduction as they spawn every 300 damage taken.

The Vampstache is mostly a novelty, on paper they have great synergy, both making the King attacking faster to heal more (which may let him tank more damage than Spiky Ball max hitpoint increase) and have more health to spawn Snakes. However, there is a maximum amount of Snakes that can be spawned, and the extra damage and attack speed from Vampstache already cannot overtake the passive damage increase of Spiky Ball, not even counting the total damage Spiky Ball's ability can do.

Be careful of splash, multi-target, and fast attack defenses such as Bomb Towers , X-Bows , Multi-Target Inferno Towers , Scattershots , Multi-Archer Towers , Firespitters , Giga Inferno , and Inferno Artillery , as the Snakes will be destroyed due to their low health.
Units that can stun defenses like Diggy and Battle Drill can also be helpful to stun them.

If the Barbarian King is damaged beforehand and has released Snakes, these summoned units can distract the Inferno Tower momentarily. Should the Barbarian King continue to sustain damage via other sources (such as a nearby Ricochet Cannon ) and release more Snakes, these spawns can continue to stall the Inferno Tower and possibly prevent it from locking on until they run out.

When defending against a Barbarian King with the Snake Bracelet and Vampstache, place high-hitpoint buildings such as the Gold and Elixir Storages, a high-damage defense such as the Single-Target Inferno Tower or Monolith to potentially knock the King out and splash defenses like Scattershots, Wizard Towers, and Bomb Towers to deal with the remaining Snakes, as well as traps to help take them down.

Inferno Towers and Monolith can devastate the Barbarian King wielding the Snake Bracelet easily; however, the Snakes that he spawns can in return destroy Inferno Towers and the Monolith without a struggle. Be sure to keep splash defenses or traps around to deal with the horde of Snakes.

notes: https://clashofclans.fandom.com/wiki/Healing_Tome
The Healing Tome is a piece of Common Hero Equipment for the Grand Warden . It is unlocked when the Blacksmith is upgraded to level 6, which requires Town Hall level 13.
The Healing Tome appears as a cream-colored book with golden edges and a red heart in the middle, surrounded by a golden edge.

The Healing Tome allows the Grand Warden to cast a Healing Spell effect in the area surrounding him when he uses his ability. The area of effect is denoted by a circular ring centered around the Warden.

Unlike a conventional Healing Spell, the area of effect of the Healing Tome follows the Grand Warden such as to be centered on him. Heroes (including the Grand Warden himself) also get healed for the full amount unlike most other sources of healing; Siege Machines cannot be affected.
In addition, the Healing Tome grants increased hitpoints and massively increases the hitpoints recovery of the ability.
It can be used in the core of the base, where the Town Hall's weapon is activated/about to go down, as it will mitigate some of the effects of the death bomb and the damage from the core of the base.

It is best used in Balloon pushes, Miner and Hog Rider Hybrid, and Witch spam, as these medium troops will see a lot of noticeable healing as there can be more of them and have enough health to take full advantage of each pulse. Spam strategies can still benefit from it, since the troops used do not have very high HP, and will need constant healing.

You can also clutch low-hitpoint troops with an early activation to heal such troops if they are very important. It can also protect troops from the Poison Spell Tower, but, unless if you are attacking something important (such as the Eagle Artillery ) or if the troops are important to the attack, then using this ability is not advised for this purpose alone.

The Healing Tome's high health recovery stat also protects the Grand Warden, preventing him from being easily defeated during the ability on top of the healing. Even with this and the healing, certain high-damage defenses can still easily defeat him during the ability, such as a single-target Inferno Tower . Make sure the Warden survives for the duration of the ability, otherwise the healing effect will end prematurely. At max level, it will deliver a total 3,000 healing to all troops and heroes (provided that they have stayed in the radius of this ability for the whole duration), which gives it a lot of potential in healing, and it could support your troops in critical situations.

raw.Unlock Requirement: Buy in Dark Deal event for 3,100 Buy in Meltdown Mayhem event for 3,100 Buy in Equipment Blast event for 3,100 or purchasable from the Trader for 1,500

notes: The Dark Crown appears as a small dark-colored crown with two pointed horns wore by the Minion Prince. It has a passive ability that activates whenever 60, 120, and 180 total housing space worth of allied troops is defeated. The Minion Prince grows larger, increases his health, and boosts his damage up to three times until he is defeated, each one granting him one-third of the max health and damage increase boost.

When the Dark Crown is used in battle, a dark aura surrounds the Minion Prince. When friendly units are defeated, the aura absorbs dark energy. For every 60 housing space of troops defeated, up to 180, a circular burst radiates from the Minion Prince, and he is enlarged, growing roughly about 5% of his size, for a maximum of about 15% at its third level, which works similarly to the activated the Giant Gauntlet from the Barbarian King .

Spells cannot contribute to the ability, since they are objects and are not counted as troops. However units that summoned by spells, such as those from the Skeleton Spell , Bat Spell , Totem Spell , and Bag of Frostmites are counted as they are considered troops.
However units that summoned by spells, such as those from the Skeleton Spell , Bat Spell , Totem Spell , and Bag of Frostmites are counted as they are considered troops.
Siege Machines , cloned troops (including cloned Archer Queens ), certain spells that summon units, and the Minion Prince himself do not count.
Troops that destroy themselves in making their attack ( Wall Breakers , Yetimites , etc.) count.

The Druid does not add any housing space if he transforms into a Bear after surviving long enough in his Druid form. He does add housing space if he transforms by having his health depleted or if defeated directly by a Spring Trap .

The Dark Crown's benefits act as buffs, rather than direct modifiers to the Minion Prince's base stats. Thus, it does not stack with Rage Spells (whose higher damage buff will override the Dark Crown's damage boost) or a Life Aura generated by Apprentice Warden .

When paired with the Dark Orb , both of these Hero Equipment can synergize well in battle, especially to slow down dense areas of the base with high damage, and if the army is defeated, the Minion Prince therefore becomes stronger and may be able to finish off the base if the Dark Orb is used correctly. This also allows the player to only focus on the Dark Orb timing to increase the chance of a successful attack.

When paired with the Metal Pants , the Minion Prince can reduce the amount of damage, especially when tackling a high-damage compartment of the base. Best used in a Minion Charge, where the Minion Prince can be supported by Invisibility Spells and a Rage Spell. However, this may not be a good combo, as the passive ability will be useless if you send him alone.

When paired with the Noble Iron , the Minion Prince will first snipe at enemy buildings before he gets closer to damage his targets, but like the Dark Crown with the Metal Pants, they may not synergize well.

The Sky Wagon goes excellently with a Minion Prince using Dark Crown, as the troops it spawns can not only tank for the Minion Prince but also contribute to the Dark Crown's housing requirement (with each barrel spawning 19-23 housing space of troops alongside Clan Castle troops), allowing him to build up Dark Crown buffs more quickly.

The Minion Prince can become very dangerous for your defenses, especially if he is supported by aerial units like Dragons , Electro Dragons , Dragon Riders , and Lava Hounds . Arrange defenses and traps carefully to increase the chances of a successful defense. Defending Heroes and Clan Castle troops can also help in this regard.

raw.Unlock Requirement: Buy in Toyshop Throwdown event for 3,100 Buy in Friend or Foe event for 3,100 Buy in Cosmic Rock event for 3,100 Buy in Equipment Blast event for 3,100 or purchasable from the Trader for 1,500

notes: The Electro Boots is the second Epic piece of Hero Equipment for the Royal Champion . It made its debut in the Toyshop Throwdown event starting December 11, 2024. Since August 12, 2025, it may appear in the Trader , where it is obtainable for 1,500 Gems.

The Electro Boots is similar to that of the Royal Champion's default skin's boots, except with two leather belt straps and a metal plate bolted in the front each, with electricity connecting from the bolts to the back, with iron soles with grooves on the bottom. When equipped, the Royal Champion gains a blue electric aura which emits lightning bolts in a clockwise motion around her which deals constant damage. This ability persists until she is knocked out from battle or is paused by recalling her, and is resumed when revived or redeployed.
In addition to the ability, the Electro Boots grants additional hitpoints to the Royal Champion , and gives her self healing every second.

When the Electro Boots are equipped with the Royal Champion, she summons an aura around herself, granting her the ability to damage buildings and units, whether ground or air. The aura's range is longer than Royal Champion's normal attack, in practice she will do extra damage per second of the aura to her target, on top of other non defensive buildings she skipped past, massively increasing her damage output.

The Electro Boots allows the Royal Champion to counter swarms of defending Clan Castle troops, especially Archers , Witches and Lava Hounds (and their summoned units). It can also be used to destroy the Skeletons from Skeleton Traps , covering her weakness.

When paired with the Hog Rider Puppet , it can be useful as she becomes invisible for a short duration and the Hog Riders will be safe against Skeletons from Skeleton Traps with her aura. Be careful of Traps such as Giant Bombs , though.

When paired with the Haste Vial or Seeking Shield , it can be helpful as it can help to destroy defenses faster, combined with the aura damage. In a Royal Champion Charge, it is best to use the ability before recalling her.

When paired with the Rocket Spear , it allows the Royal Champion to snipe defenses from afar while keeping the defending Skeletons at bay. Additionally, if she is close to nearby buildings on her long-range state, she will eventually destroy them, which can be beneficial for cleanup later on. In a Royal Champion Charge, it is best to use the ability after recalling her.

If the Royal Champion took any damage, she will regenerate over time, eventually returning her to full health. At maximum level, paired with the max-level Royal Gem , she will regenerate from 1 hitpoint to full health in roughly 90 seconds [verify] , provided if she activated her ability. This is useful if you want to keep the Royal Champion alive so that she will be used in an increased number of attacks.

The Spirit Fox pairs well with the Royal Champion equipped with the Electro Boots as she will be able to stay invisible for a short time while she recovers health, thus increasing her survivability. To make this even better, Invisibility Spells can also be used to turn the Royal Champion invisible again after the invisibility of the Spirit Fox ends.
To make this even better, Invisibility Spells can also be used to turn the Royal Champion invisible again after the invisibility of the Spirit Fox ends.

The Royal Champion can be a formidable attacker with the Electro Boots, whose most threatening aspect on attacking is her aura, which cannot be shut down by any means; Poison Spells from Spell Towers, cards from Headhunters , and the Poison Bomb from the Town Hall 14-16s' Giga Inferno death bombs and the freeze effect, whether from Ice Golems or the Town Hall's Frost Bomb will do nothing to stop her aura.

To counter the Royal Champion, place high-damage defenses like Monoliths , Revenge Towers , and single-target Inferno Towers , as well as tanky defending units or Heroes such as the Archer Queen in a way that the Royal Champion becomes overwhelmed with damage, especially if the attacker is inexperienced, forcing her ability to be used or knocking her out from battle. You can also use high-hitpoint and damage troops in your Clan Castle such as Super Dragons and P.E.K.K.As to heavily damage her. You can also use Super Minions to damage her from afar, as she is mostly attacking defenses or other units.
